title: Concept: LDAP URL in a response
description: An ldap URL that names the directory host and a search base in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The URL names the directory service and the base the application searches, which is a direct hint for an injection against the login path.
applicability: Deployments that render an ldap URL that names the directory host and a search base into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The URL names the directory service and the base the application searches, which is a direct hint for an injection against the login path.
